programs.title: Red One
programs.desc: The third joint film of Jake Kasdan and Dwayne Johnson, after two installments of the new version of "Jumanji".The head of North Pole security and a bounty hunter search for the missing Santa Claus.

programs.title: Olivia and the Invisible Earthquake
programs.desc: Twelve-year-old Olivia, together with her younger brother Tim and her mother, must suddenly leave their current apartment and start all over again in a strange neighborhood.Wanting to protect Tim from fear and alleviate his sense of loss, the girl tells him that their move is part of the film in which he is the main character.This challenge to their imagination helps them come to terms with difficult reality.Over time, through new friendships, fun, and even a bit of magic, the siblings discover that they can truly take responsibility for their story.

programs.title: Julia
programs.desc:
The year is 1962. A cookbook written by Julia Child (Sarah Lancashire) has recently hit the bookstore.Soon, an energetic woman, a graduate of the prestigious Le Cordon Bleu school, begins to appear in American homes thanks to the television program "The French Chef".The well-liked cook, full of joy in life, also feels fulfilled in her private life.She is supported in all her activities by her loving husband Paul (David Hyde Pierce).Together, the couple become witnesses of key moments in American history and observe changes taking place in society
After returning from a trip to New York, where a gala was held in her honor, Mrs. Child attends dinner with her publisher.The atmosphere of the meeting is not the best, but the casual comment made by a respected chef that day truly inspires a woman.Some time later, a chance meeting with a feminist icon makes Julia lose her good mood.Meanwhile, back at the hotel, Avis is incredibly honest with the recovering Paul, and Alice makes new friends.

programs.title: First Man
programs.desc: The 1960s, the times of the Cold War.The USA and the USSR are engaged in an arms race.The competition also concerns the conquest of space.Test pilot and astronaut Neil Armstrong leads the pioneering Gemini 8 mission, which marks the first-ever docking of two spacecraft in orbit.The test does not go according to plan, as the daredevils lose control of the connected machines.Their lives hang in the balance.However, Neil demonstrates extraordinary skills and self-control, thanks to which he and his companion, David Scott, successfully return to Earth.A year after the tragedy of the Apollo 1 crew, who died during the launch simulation, Armstrong becomes commander of the Apollo 11 mission. It will go down in history.Its goal is to land a man on the Moon.

programs.title: P.S. I Love You
programs.desc: After the death of her husband Gerry (Gerard Butler), Holly (Hilary Swank) falls into a deep depression.On her 30th birthday, a woman receives a mysterious parcel.The cake comes with a tape with a recorded message from... Gerry.He encourages his beloved to go out and have fun with friends.After this event, new letters regularly arrived to the young widow, each ending with a declaration of love.Gerry knew how much his wife would suffer from losing him.In letters written before her death, he encourages her to take on various challenges.Thanks to her extraordinary sense of connection with the deceased, a woman in despair undergoes specific therapy and tries to start her life anew.

programs.title: Superman
programs.desc: Superman (David Corenswet) stops the president of Boravia from invading Jarhanpur.This brings down the ire of Lex Luthor (Nicholas Hoult), who had an interest in this war.After returning to Metropolis, the superman is defeated by a strongman serving his enemy called the Hammer of Boravia.Luthor also broadcasts a message from Superman's parents to the entire country, urging him to conquer the Earth.Although Lois Lane (Rachel Brosnahan), the girlfriend of superhero Clark Kent's alter ego, assures him that she believes in his goodness, he wants to clear his name.He surrenders to the US authorities, who hand him over to Luthor.The antagonist traps Superman in an alternate reality along with his other enemies.Lois frees her beloved, and when he recovers in the home of his adoptive parents, Martha (Neva Howell) and Jonathan (Pruitt Taylor Vince), he once again fights for peace, with the help of members of the Justice Gang.Meanwhile, Lois is busy exposing Luthor's shenanigans to the public.

programs.title: Last Swim
programs.desc: Ziba (Deba Hekmat), whose family comes from Iran, lives in London and is an ambitious young woman.However, she hides a painful secret that none of her friends know about.Ziba has just gotten into university, where she is going to study astrophysics.On this occasion, he meets with his friends: Tara (Lydia Fleming), Shea (Solly McLeod) and Merf (Jay Lycurgo), with whom he intends to celebrate this event.She feels irritated when she learns that they are to be joined by a promising young football player, Malcolm (Denzel Baidoo), whom she does not know.Soon, however, an event occurs that makes him emotionally closer to her than her long-time friends.The future for both of them is not as bright as it might seem.Sasha Nathwani's feature-length directorial debut.

programs.title: House of the Dragon 2
programs.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.
